answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 34908 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to affix the Quranic verses at the door of the toilet or on the urinal Question: Is it permissible to affix the Quranic verses at the door of the toilet or on the urinal? It may fell inside the toilet causing 'be-adabi' of the verse. The verse is" Allahumma in-nee a'oothu bika minalkhubu-thee wal khabaa ith" Answer ID: 34908 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1664/1141/L=1432) It is not right to stick Quranic verses or duas in toilet or istinja khana (urinal); because it will cause desecration of the verse or duas. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
